purpose: Selection-only existing-data proxy pilot. Original finals are reserved and never scored.
rules: Development proxy only; original final splits and untouched cities remain reserved and unscored.
All compared models refit from pinned ImageNet initialization on the same purged candidate pool.
No shared parcel source IDs or distance below 500 m between training and any original selection/final tile.
Lower-rise morphology does not establish a suburb, village, building height or regional transfer.
Clipped references remain in primary F1; interior recall is a separate guarded diagnostic.

scoring.selection_rule: Equal region weight, then equal original geographic-block weight; macro parcel F1.

cadastre.warning: Current cadastral geometry is compared with 2023/2024 imagery; changes may be temporal.

imagery.rights: Croatian public-sector data (City of Zagreb CDOF 2022; state DOF likewise), paid by the taxpayer and free for research use including model training; verified by the project owner on 2026-10-12
imagery.source: DGU DOF 2023/24, INSPIRE WMS for anonymous users, native 0.5 m, requested at 0.15 m/px as 3x3-tile blocks (3,072 px) whose centre tile carries the service watermark and is never kept; tiles cut from the served JPEG and stored as JPEG quality 95

practice_region.legal_tradition: civil law; Austro-Hungarian (Franciscan) cadastre lineage, DKP via OSS WFS
practice_region.note: delineation practice follows the legal/survey tradition and climate/soil of the region, so donors for uncovered cities are chosen by country, then climate class, then distance
